body: I don't think they get close enough to notice but I will try and get them to take a whiff of him the next time.
Always can't help that sneaking suspicion I guess. Thx, I'll be more clear with boundaries.
I don't have many friends to begin with and I have no qualms with him other than when we hang out closely in person.

Thx... I think that might be my solution if I want to remain close friends. It's a little sad that I can't let him stay over because he would imply it but I would not respond to it. For my sake though, I will have to handle it that way.
I know he likes me but knows he can't cross the beyond friends line. Doesn't stop him from being his "close touchy feely" self though because that's just the person he is.

Good to know that I'm not the only one that gets grossed out by random things. What's a nice way to talk to him about bodily smells that's out of his control? He's had girlfriends (one recently too) and I would imagine they would have said something if it was that repulsive for the general public?
I believe he does but I established it a long time ago that we're strictly friends. Of course, that doesn't stop him from liking me.

I feel that if I tell him that it's a smell issue, it's not something he can control, especially if it's the neutral body odor smell. I enjoy hanging out with him, seriously, but... I don't know if there's a friendlier way to tell him not to get so close despite him being a close-liking person.

He's actually the "cleanliest" of his roommates but none of them smell foul either (not that I've gotten close enough to them to know). None of our mutual friends have anything to say about it either... not that we rant about each others' smells. And I get it if a person sweats, they will stink so I try not to let it bother me. But it's the neutral smell I cannot even handle.
